core_mechanism: unified local synaptic rule with three additive components: (1) centered Hebbian covariance Δw ∝ (x-x̄)(y-ȳ), (2) Oja-style stabilization -y²·w, (3) local supervised drive (t-y)·x at the output layer only. Feedback pathway (anima Engine G) is plastic under the same local rule. No backprop, no global error broadcast, no cross-entropy in the optimization objective.
